attempts.recovery: Restored both prior code hashes, removed the two newly added files, restarted the service, and verified health plus a 200 session request before fixing the candidate.

runtimeEvidence.summary: All four deployed runtime and migration files matched the 9cfe202 candidate hashes after the final restart.
A transactionally rolled-back dry run and the final idempotent apply both produced migration 0024, the owner/session indexes, and least-privilege wow_app access.
A real successful Agent job produced exactly one linked Trace; request and answer text were absent and a wrong-owner store read raised not found.
The prior code answered normally with the additive table retained and no new Trace, after which the exact candidate was restored and produced one new Trace.
Localhost and public health passed, no new async sync/backfill was started, existing timer states were recorded, and recent backend warnings were empty.

corrections: Unknown but format-valid request-scope slugs now collapse to empty categorical dimensions before projection.
The SQLite compatibility migration ledger now invalidates the prior init fast-path so existing databases create the Trace table once.
PostgreSQL migration 0024 now explicitly limits wow_app to SELECT and INSERT so runtime Trace writes do not depend on historic default privileges.
postgres_personal_store now imports the Trace validator in both package and production script-entrypoint modes, covered by a subprocess regression test.

Fresh SQLite compatibility reads now run the idempotent schema initializer before selecting Chickenbro profiles; a clean-worktree red-green test prevents stateful test order from masking the contract.
assertions: No prompt, answer, message content, Tool fact, character or realm, report identity, URL, token, or stdout enters Trace or projection.
No Tool selection, prompt, model schema, answer validation, public API, or frontend file changed.
No Trace error can mask a validated answer or original generation failure.
No Phase 2-5 table, runtime, flag, or lifecycle status exists.

risks.detail: Exact candidate file parity, PostgreSQL migration, real owner-bound Trace creation, wrong-owner isolation, service health, and code rollback/restore were verified on the known cloud server.
Phase 1 records deterministic terminal outcomes only; it does not infer user correction, create shared facts, cluster CapabilityGap, or promote abilities.

rollback: Restore the previous backend and personal-store code/build identity, restart wow-backend, and retain the additive 0024 Trace table.
Do not delete owner-bound Trace, message, session, or Agent job rows during code rollback.

cleanup.reason: After main@22db29a reached exact origin parity, the task and verification worktrees plus the local and published task branches were removed. The PostgreSQL backup and additive Trace data were retained.

summary: Chickenbro capability evolution Phase 1 is merged, verified, and archived. Merge commit c1d5c52 integrated bounded owner-isolated Trace persistence, deterministic outcome mapping, text-free projection, and four-case offline Eval without changing frontend or answer policy. Final source commit 22db29a additionally closes the fresh-SQLite test-order precondition and passed the complete 173-command Harness from an empty database state; local and origin main parity was verified before archive capture, task resources were removed, and the live PostgreSQL runtime remains immutably bound to verified candidate 9cfe202.
